# Mediabunny 1.66.4

`mediabunny-1.66.4.mjs` is the unmodified browser bundle `dist/bundles/mediabunny.min.mjs` from the published `mediabunny@1.66.4` package. Journey Studio loads it on demand to encode and mux local H.264 MP4 video through WebCodecs.

- Upstream and source code: https://github.com/Vanilagy/mediabunny
- Exact distribution, including its original source files: https://registry.npmjs.org/mediabunny/-/mediabunny-1.66.4.tgz
- Documentation: https://mediabunny.dev/guide/writing-media-files
- License: Mozilla Public License 2.0, reproduced in `MEDIABUNNY-LICENSE.txt`. Source files for this covered bundle are available in the exact distribution linked above.
- Package SHA-512: `VIPwwaVpY5mUnf9mAOJlBii4P1nHK05X8//veRjJrddn514BSOuYaMrUy1UReLMVVsm85id6eMu0z5K71Kkf+g==`

The bundle is unmodified; application code using it is in `../journey-video.mjs`. No media is uploaded to Mediabunny or another encoding service.
